evidence.quote: All courses are taught in English; therefore, a B2 level English proficiency is required.
The tuition fee for this program is 7,000 USD/Year

notes: The programme page states documents and general application steps; the application platform quote is general but applies to all applicants. Tuition is stated only in USD by the pages; other currencies not given. The non-refundable application fee of 150 USD and entrance procedure fee of 350 USD are extra costs, not tuition.

evidence.quote: Applicants must have an English proficiency of at least B2 level as the program is fully taught in English.
a TOEFL test with a minimum score of 513 (Paper-Based).
an IELTS test with a minimum score of 5.5.

note.fr: Vérifiez l'exigence d'un examen d'entrée en mathématiques et les modalités d'inscription.
note.en: Check the Mathematics entrance exam requirement and registration details.
